Summary written by @makers/deepseek-v4-flash (3211 ms)

data.narrative: Authentication and session management were supported: invalid passwords were rejected, valid login succeeded, and logout redirected back to sign-in. No sensitive data exposure in the browser was supported: no passwords, errors, or unexpected outside connections were observed during sign-in. Enterprise-grade role-based access control was contradicted with high severity: a standard signed-in user could retrieve 24 account records, including admin accounts, from /api/Users/, showing access is enforced in the interface but not by the API.
